name: Numerical Methods for Hyperbolic PDEs
description:
Scalar conservation laws: Method of characteristics, Shocks, Rarefactions, weak and entropy solutions, existence and uniqueness results, Finite volume schemes, Riemann solvers, Convergence of first order schemes.
High-order schemes: Lax-Wendroff, TVD schemes, Limiters, ENO schemes, higher-order Runge-Kutta methods.
Linear systems: Exact solutions, First- and high-order finite volume schemes. 
Non-linear Systems: Solutions of Riemann problems, First-Order finite volume schemes for systems.
High-order schemes for systems: TVD Limiters. Finite-volume schemes on unstructured meshes. Hyperbolic systems with source term
